name: Ellmarch Post 6 Original
description: This listing is a desorption-stage drying rack listed with drying chamber volume 2929 litres, air temperature 112 degrees Celsius, moisture removal 262 kilograms per day. Its remaining stated figures are batch drying 62 hours, unit price set after acceptance, airflow pattern cross-flow. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
